scenes.headline: How Qwen3.8-Max learned to work unsupervised for days
scenes.sub: 2.4T parameters, 95B active, trained across many agent harnesses.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Beet! Qwen3.8-Max has two point four trillion parameters, ninety-five billion active. Its best evidence is what it built alone.

scenes.label: Alibaba's bet
scenes.text: Scale RL environments, one universal reward and a balanced data mix together, and working competence lifts across several harnesses at once.
scenes.say: Alibaba's bet: scale environments, one reward and a balanced data mix together, and competence lifts across several harnesses at once.

items.say: Environments grow along independent axes, task, workspace and harness, so growth compounds instead of needing bespoke integration.
One reward system unifies execution checks, rubric judging and agentic inspection, instead of a pile of task-specific verifiers.
And an online balancer evens every batch across task, difficulty, workspace and harness, so gradient variance doesn't blow up.

scenes.title: A harness that fixes its own issues

steps.say: Case one: a command-line tool from an empty repository. An agent leases an issue from a state machine, and implements it.
Every change runs build, unit, end-to-end and desktop checks.
Passing pull requests merge. Failures route back to the issue that started them.
Feedback and its own test results return as new issues. About sixteen days in: two hundred and sixty-five commits, none merged by a human.

scenes.label: gates in a crypto accelerator, over about 500 turns with no human
scenes.note: one rewrite at turn 22 cut 6,288 gates
scenes.say: Case two, a chip. Over about five hundred turns, it cut the gate count from eight thousand two hundred and ninety-eight to six hundred and seventy-eight.

left.title: The benchmark table
items: Terminal Bench 2.1 at avg@10, rivals at best published
left.say: The benchmark table is real, but its footnotes admit different harnesses and competitor judges.

right.title: The case studies
items: A public commit trail, read commit by commit
The chip checked through place and route
right.say: The case studies leave traces you can check: a public commit history, and a chip taken through place and route.

scenes.text: A public commit trail and a benchmark table are different kinds of evidence. This release offers both, and labels which is which.
scenes.say: A commit trail and a benchmark table are different evidence. This release offers both, and says which is which.

recap: Environments, reward and data mix scaled together
A harness that files, fixes and merges its issues
A chip cut from 8,298 to 678 gates
scenes.say: To recap: one reward across many environments, a self-fixing harness, and a chip that kept shrinking.
